latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor Free — edit, trim, and export videos for free.

- Edit raw videos by trimming, merging, adding text overlays, and exporting without any fees or watermarks.
- Simple conversational workflow — describe edits in plain language without technical complexity.
- Free, no-login token system: 100 credits per session, 7-day validity.
- Cloud-based editing with support for popular formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, gif, mp3, wav, etc).
- Automatic handling of session, authentication, errors, and user feedback throughout the editing process.
